description: This Java class defines a command object 'BlockNamespace' used for blocking signals to a specific namespace within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes factory methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and overrides methods like toString and setDittoHeaders.

classes.name: BlockNamespace
classes.description: A command class representing a request to block signals from a specific namespace, immutable and JSON-serializable.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BlockNamespace with the specified namespace and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a BlockNamespace instance from a JSON object and headers, deserializing the JSON structure.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of BlockNamespace with the given headers, copying the namespace from current.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of BlockNamespace, used for equality purposes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
